subject: rCharts with shiny : no axis y auto scale

messages.author: 3255980cfb4fb14b
messages.subject: rCharts with shiny : no axis y auto scale
parts:
Hello,

I created an application with shiny and the excellent rCharts.
When I execute my code in R, no worries. If I remove a curve, the y axis is auto updated(scaled) according to the others data. However when I execute this code in shiny, the auto scale does'nt work.
I tried with many codes found on internet, and i have the same problem. The auto scale does not work when I execute it with shiny.

thank for your answers.

messages.author: 3255980cfb4fb14b
messages.subject: Re: rCharts with shiny : no axis y auto scale
parts:
The problem was due to a shiny update ( 0.8 to 0.9.)
with the 0.8, no problem.
